16. The ✨ / 🧹 / ⏳ chips and the training 1–5 rating — words only

None of these is in the picture fixture (no answered grade, no family chore, nothing waiting with Mum, no training that has ended), so there is no picture. What changed, state by state:

  • ✨ answered chip (yellow fill kept), 🧹 family chores chip (amber border and pale fill kept), ⏳ N with Mum chip (paper): border 2.5px → 2px; words 0.94rem, normal weight → 0.95rem, bold (700); inside space 0.4rem 0.8rem → 0 0.75rem, still at least 44px tall; space between the emoji and the words 0.4rem → 0.25rem (--space-1); round pill ends unchanged.
  • Training 1–5, not pressed: corner 12px → pill (round ends); number 16px, heaviest (800) → 0.95rem, bold (700); 2px ink border and paper fill unchanged; still at least 44 × 44px.
  • Training 1–5, pressed: blue fill (--accent-blue with its ink) → the kit's pressed colour --pill-on (Pop: the strong accent with its ink; Calm: navy with white numbers). The look now follows aria-pressed, which the buttons already carried, so a screen reader hears the same as before.
  • Mouse pointer: over the chips and the 1–5 the pointer no longer turns into a hand (the kit chip sets no cursor).
  • Hover: ✏️ Plan my day / Modify my plan and the fold buttons (Later today, Earlier today, all done, Got it, Never mind, To-dos and goals) no longer turn pale grey under a mouse pointer (the kit buttons have no hover look). On the iPad, with a finger, nothing differs.
